title: Fields named or path-labelled with a PII category are redacted at the boundary regardless of call-site discipline
asA: operator concerned that PII leaks through logs
iWant: the emission boundary to redact fields with named PII categories automatically
soThat: a rogue caller that forgets to redact does not leak PII to the log destination

acceptanceCriteria.description: A log payload containing a field named or path-tagged with any of the recommended-default categories (credential, pii.email, pii.name, pii.address, token, bearer) is replaced with the literal string [REDACTED:<category>] in the emitted line; the caller's original object is not mutated (a subsequent read of the same object still shows the original value).
acceptanceCriteria.given: an emission at any level whose payload includes a field tagged as pii.email
acceptanceCriteria.when: the emission passes through the boundary
acceptanceCriteria.then: the stdout line's field value equals [REDACTED:pii.email] and the caller-side object still holds the original address

acceptanceCriteria.description: A project may add its own redaction categories at apply through the ADR-1603 elicited-additions parameter; a new category name (kebab or dotted-namespace) is accepted and applied by the boundary in the same round.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project that elicited an additional category ssn on ADR-1603
acceptanceCriteria.when: an emission includes a field tagged ssn
acceptanceCriteria.then: the stdout line's field value equals [REDACTED:ssn]
